description: This file defines the PHP class 'CodeGuruSecurityClient' that extends the 'AwsClient' class to interact with the Amazon CodeGuru Security service. It also includes method annotations for various operations related to findings, scans, and resource management.

classes.name: CodeGuruSecurityClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon CodeGuru Security service, providing methods for managing scans, findings, and configurations.

methods.name: batchGetFindings
methods.description: Retrieves multiple findings by their IDs.

methods.name: createUploadUrl
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed URL for uploading data.

methods.name: getFindings
methods.description: Retrieves findings based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getScan
methods.description: Gets details of a specific scan.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.
